title: Sprint 13 Mid-Sprint Check
raw_text:
Sarah: Status update on the dashboard. Karim, where are we?

Karim: The API contracts were delivered to Youssef on March 28 as planned. I have two of the five endpoints done. But I still do not know who is designing the MongoDB collections. Nobody picked that up.

Omar: I set up the MongoDB cluster on staging. It is running. But like I said last week, I do not do schema design. That is not my area.

Sarah: Karim, just take ownership of the MongoDB schema design. You know the data best.

Karim: Fine, but then the dashboard deadline of April 4 is impossible. I need at least until April 11.

Sarah: April 11 works. The dashboard deadline is now April 11.

Lina: I want to flag that the client demo is on April 8. We promised them a working dashboard.

Sarah: We will show them a partial demo on April 8 with the two endpoints Karim already built. The full version ships April 11.

Lina: That is risky. The client expects the filtering feature specifically.

Sarah: Noted. Karim, make the filtering endpoint your third priority so it is ready for the demo.

Karim: I will try. No guarantees.

Sarah: Do your best. Meeting closed.
